name: 经典百搭丝光棉短袖T恤款
description: 欧美简约百搭版型、面料细腻带光泽、三色可选易搭配

styleLock.backgroundSystem: clean white #FFFFFF for packshots and size charts, light warm grey #F2F2F0 for variant and CTA screens, warm beige #EFE9DF for atelier scene and trust screens
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright soft daylight-studio lighting, front-left or window key from the left, soft contact shadows, no harsh speculars
styleLock.surfaceSystem: smooth studio backdrop with matte neutral garment boards #EFE9DF / #F2F2F0
styleLock.typography: modern bold geometric sans-serif headline type only, short hashtag-style Chinese subtitles wrapped in 「」, flat rectangular highlight bars behind section titles
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line icons only, single mustard gold accent #D9A845
styleLock.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hero angle and scale for the garment across the set; ghost-mannequin or neat fold presentation; tidy grid layout
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium menswear atelier visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white #FFFFFF, light warm grey panel #F2F2F0, warm beige #EFE9DF, charcoal text #2D2D2D and one mustard gold accent #D9A845; bright soft daylight-studio lighting with a front-left or window key and soft contact shadows; modern bold geometric sans-serif headline type only, with short hashtag-style Chinese subtitles wrapped in 「」; consistent flat rectangular highlight bars behind section titles; consistent thin-line icon style in one gold accent; clean high-end menswear photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable slight 3/4 hero angle and scale for the garment; tidy grid layout; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，干净合规的主图
shots.camera: front view at a slight 3/4 angle on an invisible ghost mannequin, eye-level, full garment visible and centered
shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio lighting, front-left key with soft fill, one soft contact shadow grounding the garment
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Front view at a slight 3/4 angle on an invisible ghost mannequin, eye-level, full garment visible and centered, filling 60-70% of the frame on the clean white sweep. Bright even high-key studio lighting with a front-left key and soft fill, one soft contact shadow grounding the garment. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF. Even breathing margins on all four sides, nothing else in the frame. 8K, commercial menswear e-commerce quality. Negative: no props, no model, no hands, no hanger, no watermark, no fake logo, no extra text, no wrinkles clutter, no cut-off edges.

provenance.notes: 从 7 张男装 T 恤详情长图切片提炼；已剥离源品牌字样、模特长相、原文案、二维码与店铺水印，产品一律以 {product} 占位；源图中的灰色占位框仅提取其版式节奏，不带入其填充内容，尺码数据以通用表头加示例短值由商家回填。
